summary: The Acura RL was a mid-sized executive luxury car made by Honda's Acura division over two generations for the 1996 to 2012 model years. It served as Acura's flagship, succeeding the Acura Legend, and was replaced in 2013 by the Acura RLX. The note also says the Legend, RL and RLX lines were all adapted from the Japanese domestic market Honda Legend, and that the name RL stands for Refined Luxury.
one_line: The Acura RL was Honda's Acura division's flagship mid-sized luxury sedan, built from 1996 to 2012 and succeeded by the RLX.
key_facts: The Acura RL is a mid-sized / executive luxury car.
The Acura RL was manufactured by the Acura division of Honda.
The Acura RL was produced for the 1996–2012 model years.
The Acura RL was built over two generations.
The Acura RL was the flagship of the Acura marque.
The Acura RL succeeded the Acura Legend.
The Acura RL was replaced in 2013 by the Acura RLX.
All models of the Legend, RL and RLX lines have been adapted from the Japanese domestic market Honda Legend.
The model name "RL" is an abbreviation for "Refined Luxury."
